d:
Jalvayu parivartan se jujh rahi duniya ke lie ilektrik gariyon ko ek solyushan ke taur par dekha ja raha hai. bharat men, mahindra last mail mobiliti ne ilektrik otoriksha pesh kie hain, jo na sirf karban emishan kam karte hain, balki saikron mahilaon ko rozi-roti bhi de rahe hain. is pahal ko 'da arthashot praiz 2026' men nomineshan mila hai.
